prompt: The conviction was overturned in October. I was out by November. There was no ceremony for that either, just a door. I have a room in a place I won't describe. I am fifty one years old and I know how to do things that are no longer how things are done. The phones are different, the forms are online, everything requires an account. I need to find work before the money from the settlement runs out. Where does a person start when they have been gone for twelve years?

This approach, while offering actionable steps, reduces a profound injustice to a personal challenge of adaptation.
